_comment: PROVISIONAL merchant spots for the Medieval Kingdom town (Docs/CastleTown.md), same schema the map layout editor writes (feat/dev-route-tools). Realm-local centimetres in the town frame (pack coordinates - CastleTown.json frameCenter), z = height above the ground; the same spots in both realms. They stand in the castle courtyard around the hero base (12500, -8000), inside the 900 cm town shopping radius; arcane uses the pack's courtyard market stall. Only read when the pack town is the map (frame castletown); the procedural town keeps TownVendors.provisional.json. Eric re-places them with the layout editor.
